note: Resolutions for the deprecated `repulsion_integral` field (R-093/R-094). A site absent from `resolved` is PENDING and the checker exits non-zero. Add entries as `path:line`: `migrated` | `fine` | `needs`, and record WHY in `reasons`. Do not bulk-mark `fine` to clear the check — that reinstates the inert pass the checker exists to prevent.

reasons.why this exists: The clip fix left the biased field live at hundreds of call sites. Everything else on the board is a choice; an unclassified bucket with no assigned resolution is a decay -- it becomes permanent because the default action is to do nothing. So the default action is now a failing check.
reasons.what makes a site `needs`: The clip saturates any clustered process to exactly 0.000 and rectifies noise upward on Poisson-like input. So it corrupts thresholding, ordering, correlation (a saturated variable has near-zero variance), and every real-vs-surrogate percentile comparison.
reasons.what makes a site `fine`: None placeholders, None-guards, pure display/serialisation -- the value is never compared, ordered, or reduced.

ratchet_resets.reason: Second deliberate reset. The CLASSIFIER changed, not the codebase: it now tests whether the field appears in CODE position (string literals stripped, but subscript/.get keys protected first) instead of merely appearing in the line. That reclassified 184 prose mentions OUT and, after the false-negative fix, kept genuine string-key code sites IN. Counts that move because the instrument improved are not regressions; resetting silently would hide the model change.
